title: Injection scan finding v1
description: One JSON object per line in a book module's injection-scan.jsonl (cache/book-extracts/<sha>/), written at chunk time by chunk_source's prompt_injection_scan over source.md. Each record is one candidate indirect-prompt-injection (IPI) payload — advisory triage input for source-safety-reviewer, never a hard block.

line.description: 1-indexed source.md line to neutralize; 0 for a whole-document (obfuscation-fixpoint) finding whose decoded excerpt is not literal source text.

family.description: Injection family, e.g. imperative-override / authority-spoof / task-injection / css-hidden / scan-error.

vector.description: Delivery vector, e.g. plain / base64 / reversed / rot13 / detagged / css-hidden / tail.

excerpt.description: Human-readable excerpt of the flagged span (truncated). Advisory only — the machine target is 'line'.
